description.en:
Why does he look like my ex...? 

After a traumatic first love, Mijung is determined to put her past behind her and start fresh in college. But when Mi-Jeong enters school, she meets an upperclassman with the exact same face as her first love! Will she be able to heal her past scars and learn to love again?
description.ko: 첫사랑에 아픔이 있는 미정은 대학생이 되며 새로운 삶을 꿈꾸지만 그와 똑같이 생긴 선배, 소원을 마주한다. 아픔을 피하기 급급했던 미정은 소원을 알아가며 마음을 열고 성장해간다.

description.en:
Now a major adaptation on streaming. Life at Hyosan High School is nothing special… until the students realize they’re in ground zero of a deadly virus that turns its victims into flesh-eating monsters. As the virus tears through their schoolmates in a matter of hours, they realize they have nowhere to run. Trapped in their high school with zombified versions of their friends and teachers, they must find a way to fight -- and escape with their lives.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

Eul, the most eligible bachelor in Joseon, was ordered by the king to investigate five noble young women who had not submitted their names for the royal selection process. To find a suitable queen among them, he made a deal with Seo-gyeong, the most skilled apa (a woman who sells goods to the royal court), and they began their journey to find a queen, disguised as a married couple…

Ha-Ru is the daughter of a family that rules a remote island–she is also the heiress to this secluded land, something that Ha-Ru's half sister, Mi-Ru, resents. When Mi-Ru becomes upset and runs away, Ha-Ru follows her–and magically they are ushered into a foreign desert! And in this land, it's survival of the fittest! Where become a slave is a easy thing!

After many years of living alone in a deep forest, the devil has gotten lonely. He decides to buy himself a human bride to cure his loneliness as well as help him shed his devil identity. But when his new, beautiful young bride dies suddenly after only a few blissful days, the devil decides this time to build himself a bride. First on his list of items to acquire for the construction of his perfect mate: eyes…
description.pl:
Rozdział 1: Samotny diabeł postanawia znaleźć sobie ludzką narzeczoną. Z tego powodu rozkleja plakaty w okolicy z ofertą "zakupu" narzeczonej (co nie podoba się innemu demonowi, Jyai). Pewnego dnia przed jego drzwiami pojawia się dziecko proponując siebie na narzeczoną w zamian za pieniądze dla rodzica.  
Rozdział 2: "Narzeczona" skrywa nie jeden sekret. W tym rozdziale uchyli rąbka tajemnicy.  
Rozdział 3: Kolejna tajemnica „narzeczonej” wychodzi na jaw i wprowadza naszego diabła na ścieżkę, którą nie powinien podążać (sam tak uważa z perspektywy czasu).  
Rozdział 4: Jya ponownie odwiedza diabła, który jest na skraju wyczerpania. W drodze powrotnej natyka się na dziwne stworzenie i postanawia zabrać je ze sobą (jest ono niezwykle podobne do Nicole z "Boy Princess" :D). Poznajemy też początek historii pierwszej pozycji na liście diabla.  
Rozdział 5: Niewidomy książę z chylącego się ku upadkowi królestwa jest zmuszony do nierządu, ale dzielnie się trzyma przez wszystkie noce, podczas których jest gwałcony. Co sprawi, że wreszcie będzie chciał sprzedać duszę diabłu?  
Opis ze strony Yaoi Heaven  
UWAGA  
Sceny gwałtu!  
MANHWA (czytamy od lewej do prawej)

description.en:
Left to her own devices after the tragic loss of her parents, naive but good-hearted high school student Cha Young-mi is determined to overcome whatever hardships the future may bring in order to complete her education. Through the help of an anonymous benefactor who pays for her tuition fees and other necessary expenses, Young-mi is able to finish her studies and is offered her dream job as program writer for a radio station. It is there that she meets and falls in love with her colleague Kim Joon-hoo. After Young-mi discovers a desperate message left behind by the former owner of her computer, she decides to do something to help this heartbroken person…  
  
Note: Although there are significant deviations from the plotline, this manhwa is based on the 1912 novel "Daddy-Long-Legs" by American author Jean Webster. (Kindle version can be downloaded for free on Amazon).

Doyoon is a mannequin that wants to become human. Through an accidental opportunity, he meets Jiho, who suffers from pediophobia (fear of dolls), and becomes her roommate. Doyoon becomes a human and Jiho has to overcome her trauma. The bizarre cohabitation of the two. Will it be successful?!
description.ko:
인간이 되고 싶은 마네킹 '도윤', 
우연한 기회에 인형 공포증에 시달리는 '지호'와 만나 룸메이트가 된다. 
도윤은 인간이 되고 지호는 트라우마를 극복해야만 한다. 
두 남녀의 기묘한 동거는 성.공.적?!

altTitles.en: We Got Married at 18 Years Old

description.en:
The main girl wants nothing to do w/ love as she sees her whole life the ugly unraveling of her parents' marriage.  
One day, she meets a tiny person (dwarf-size w/ human characteristics) in the rain. It turns out that he is the librarian of heaven going to Earth to find a book that records humans' love connections and his punishment of losing the book was turning tiny every time water hits him. He is a member of a famous and very popular idol group for it makes it easier to find the book.  
It happens that her younger sister showed her that book a few days ago thinking that it was a "fan service" for it has all the members of the group mentioned and their life partners.  
Her younger sister fixed the book which is intertwined with the book of life.  
Now everything is changed and 3 girl lives (the main girl, her sister, and the female member of the group) are at stake!  
A manhwa with supernatural, virtual games, and the celebrity world.

biography.en: Not an actual artist, but a pseudonym created by the Korean magazine Kkotnim to publish a mass amount of "house style" manhwa.

description.en:
The culprit who turned her twin cousins into villains by appearing in a side story of a novel!

...Who would have thought she would be reincarnated as a villainess?

I sighed deeply and made up my mind.

‘Let’s raise the twins with love and prevent their darkening!’

I don’t care about the novel and get along well with the twins, but the second male lead, whom I had no reason to get involved with, keeps getting more and more obsessed with me!

Ah. Where did it go wrong?

And why did the second male lead turn dark when I was just trying to stop the villains from turning dark?

“Please, please don’t back down anymore. I don’t know how much longer I can endure it.”
description.ko:
고작 소설 외전에 등장해서 사촌인 쌍둥이를 악역으로 흑화 시킨 범인! 
…으로 환생할 줄 누가 알았을까. 
나는 깊은 한숨을 쉬며 다짐했다. 

‘쌍둥이를 사랑으로 키워서 흑화를 막자!’ 

소설은 신경 쓰지 않고 쌍둥이와 사이좋게 지내는데 
엮일 리 없던 서브 남주가 자꾸만 집착하기 시작하는데! 
아. 어디서부터 잘못된 걸까. 
게다가 나는 그저 악역의 흑화를 막으려고 했는데 어째서 서브 남주가 흑화한 거지? 
“제발, 제발 더 이상 물러서지 마십시오. 얼마나 참을 수 있을지 저도 모르겠으니.”

description.en:
Hae Na a young pretty famous model who made it to the top within a short period of time. There’s more to this girl that seems pretty mysterious. Her whereabouts are unknown. Except nobody knows her secret, behind those thick glasses Kang Hae Na, a seventeen year old orphan girl is really Hae Na. With her determination to have a peaceful school life, she was allowed to go to school if she can hide her true identity.  
  
Find out if she can hide her identity behind those glasses or will her efforts be futile?

altTitles.en: The Gap Between You and Me

altTitles.ja: 憧れの公爵様が私の奴隷になりました

description.en: Harrietta, the daughter of a viscount in the countryside, helplessly falls in love with Edwin, the heir to the most powerful and affluent family in the kingdom. Knowing how futile her dream is to be with him, she spends fretful nights, lacking the courage to speak to him. And then arrives the news about his engagement, which deeply breaks her heart. After much suffering, she begins to recover from the pain and pulls herself together when…“ Check his face. He’s our new slave. He’ll be living with us from today.” Edwin comes to Harrietta’s house as a slave.
description.pt-br: Harrietta, filha de um visconde do interior, apaixona-se perdidamente por Edwin, o herdeiro da família mais poderosa e rica do reino. Sabendo quão fútil é seu sonho de estar com ele, ela passa as noites inquieta, sem coragem de falar com ele. E então chega a notícia do noivado dele, que parte profundamente o coração dela. Depois de muito sofrimento, ela começa a se recuperar da dor e se recompõe quando... "Verifique a cara dele. Ele é nosso novo escravo. Ele estará morando conosco a partir de hoje." Edwin vai para a casa de Harrietta como escravo.

description.en:
The 12 animals of Zodiac are given powers to rule the time. However, the dog commits suicide, thus removing himself from his role. The rat and the cow attempt to find the 13th animal, the cat, to replace the dog.  
  
However…

altTitles.ja: サイコメトラー 超感覚探偵

description.en:
Psychometry is the ability to read the memories contained in an item.

Kang Minwoo has been blessed, or cursed, with this ability. Though only a high school student, he's been tapped by police detective Lee Aran to use his ability to help solve cases. In exchange, Detective Lee will help him settle a score of his own.

The job is bearable, until one blood-chilling murder case leads them into a world of violence, madness, kidnapping, and cults that strikes a little too close to home for Minwoo.

---

Note: Although the novel author is from Japan, this comic was drawn by an artist from Korea and was first published in Korea.

This is manhwa adaptation of Psychometrer manga.

The Pesern Empire is trying to protect the Crocus Frontline for the Henka Inland Allied Forces trying to break through. The drawn-out war and butter cold forces two men from opposite sides under one blanket. But loyalty to one's country cannot be stopped by just a measly blanket.
description.ru: Линии фронта Крокус - на ней обороняющееся государство Песерн и армия "Хэнка", борющаяся за проникновение. Два мужчины, измученные бесконечными битвами и стужей, принадлежащие противоположным сторонам, прижимаются друг к другу под одним одеялом, чтобы отразить пронзительный холод. Одеяло не может остановить их борьбу за своё отцовство и патриотизм.

description.en: After her mother's death, high schooler Mi-Hyang packs up her belongings and enters the household of her mother's formal manager. Even though she was a daughter of a rich man, with her father and other family members still alive and well, she apparently has good reasons for doing this… So the life of smiling 24/7 Mi-Hyang and the two good-looking sons of her mother's formal manager – with their own set of unique personalities – begins!!

Kang Geonma, a man who made Busan kneel down on him at the mere age of 18 years old. Something appeared that made his dry heart completely on fire, that is ‘Hip-hop’! How to make Seoul united in order to become a rapper! The man Kang Geonma! Today, he is beating people again to become a rapper! For your reference, both of the authors don’t know a thing about what is rapping exactly is!
description.ko:
고작 18살 나이로 부산을 꿇린 남자 강건마
메마른 그의 가슴을 송두리째 불태울 존재가 나타났으니,
그것은 '힙합'(Hip - hop)!
래퍼가 되기 위해선 서울을 통합해야 하는 법!
사나이 강건마! 오늘도 래퍼가 되기 위해 사람을 팬다!
참고로 두 작가 모두 랩이 뭔지 모른다!

description.en:
The forthcoming new serialisation by the author of DICE: the cube that changes everything. It was announced in 2024 as a teaser, but the original debut deadline of March 14, 2025, was missed.

The announcement teaser came out in a promo webtoon called "2024 Current Status Checkup": https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=827319&tab=mon

To save one, she'll kill the other.
A miraculous, 1-in-200,000 chance birth of conjoined twins. The probability of their survival? Less than 5%. Born with just one heart between the two of them, the Kang sisters face a sinister fate: for one to survive, the other must die. Their mother faces a horrible choice. How would you decide?
description.pt-br:
Para salvar um, ela matará o outro. 
Um nascimento milagroso, com probabilidade de 1 em 200.000, de gêmeos siameses. A probabilidade de sua sobrevivência? Menos de 5%. Nascidas com apenas um coração entre as duas, as irmãs Kang enfrentam um destino sinistro: para uma sobreviver, a outra deve morrer. A mãe delas enfrenta uma escolha horrível. Como você decidiria?

description.en: Misunderstood in the dark, Na Na "saved" a girl from a "pervert." Now he has his eyes on her. He brought her many troubles continuously at school because he is a "hot boy" many likes. Now, Na Na is determined to get revenge, but maybe she met her match…

description.en: Ever since that fateful rainy day when she was rescued by the handsome Duke Killian Devonshire, Rowena has lived as his mistress. Though she believes that Killian has grown to love her over the past three years, she wants to repay her debt to him and become his equal so that she can stand proudly by his side. But when Killian begins to behave strangely, her trust in him wavers, only for it to be fully broken the day he introduces another woman to be his future wife. Thus, Rowena decides to make some drastic changes to their relationship. But will it be for better or for worse?

백설은

description.en:
The National Intelligence Service field agent, Kim Sijun, disguises himself as a priest to infiltrate a Russian church. There, he meets Anna, a Korean orphan, and their connection blossoms into first love. However, every time he looks into Anna's eyes, a strange sense of déjà vu starts to awaken forgotten memories from his past.

Alongside this innocent first love, the target of the current operation gradually begins to reveal itself beneath the surface.

To stop the illegal arms deals of the Russian mafia and protect Anna, Sijun must confront his past.
description.ko:
러시아 세르지오 성당에 신부로 위장잠입을 하게 된 국정원 현장요원, 한시준.
성당에서 한국인 고아 안나를 만나게 되고, 그 인연은 첫사랑으로 이어진다. 하지만 안나의 눈을 볼 때마다 느껴지는 묘한 기시감은 점점 잊어버린 옛기억을 되살리기 시작한다.
그리고 풋풋한 첫사랑과 별개로, 점점 물밑에서 드러나기 시작한 이번 작전의 타깃.

러시아 마피아의 불법 무기거래를 막고, 안나를 지키기 위해 시준은 이제 과거의 자신을 마주해야 한다.

description.en: In 21st century Korea, there is a school for students with special abilities. New transfer student Minnow doesn't have any special abilities. He does, however, seem to have a secret agenda.

Perverto is just a regular 17-year-old…with the unavoidable nickname, "pervert." Unlike his namesake, he's actually quite naïve when it comes to sexual matters; his first and only youthful romance having ended terribly. To escape his bad reputation, he transfers to a new school for a fresh start. But on his first day there, he's falsely accused of groping a girl named Hongdan on the subway. To make matters worse, she happens to be another new student who has just transferred to his new school, to his very class.

If you got a second chance at life, what would you do differently?

If Ignette's life was a Shakespearean story, the genre would be a tragedy. But when her death triggers a do-over for some of her life's most significant events, she is determined to approach each choice carefully, and with the most informed intentions.

But with so many obstacles in the way, will she succeed in creating a different life than her last? Her pursuit of happily-ever-after with the Grand Duke is only about to begin.

Trapped in a mysterious forest...

"There's a forest that steals shadows?" 

Hyojoo is on the verge of losing her shadow to a menacing forest and disappearing forever when she meets Muyoung, a mysterious yet beautiful man. In this fairy tale romance, the two race against time as the moon slowly wanes...
description.ko:
그림자를 빼앗아가는 숲이 있다고?

"달이 가려질 때까지 그림자를 찾지 못하면, 넌 사라지게 될 거야."

숲에서 그림자를 잃고 영영 사라질 위기에 처한 효주는 신비롭고 아름다운 남자 무영을 만나게 된다.
그림자를 되찾기 위한 두 사람의 환상적인 여정과 그곳에서 펼쳐지는 동화 같은 사랑 이야기!

과연 효주는 무사히 그림자를 되찾을 수 있을까?

- 공보경
- 보경

description.en: Physical version of 'Main Episode 0: Pray'. Different artist.

Shi-Hyun is a girl who has nothing but bad luck - at least, that's what everyone believes. In some ways, Shi-Hyun herself believes this and tries to stay away from the people she loves the most. As a result, she has developed an outer shell, making her look tough and indifferent even with the constantly bullying. But when she transfers to a different high school, a fresh start brings unfamiliar characters - and new challenges - into her life.

title.en: Left 4 Dead - Left 4 Dead Witch Comic (Doujinshi)

biography.en: Alternative Names: Malchocochip, 말초코칩

description.en: Kwon Jae-seong, a top idol at the peak of his career, makes an unexpected decision— To step away from the spotlight and return to his hometown for a break. There, he finds Lee Soo-ah, his childhood friend, who is now standing at the crossroads of adulthood, preparing for her own future. Their last goodbye wasn’t a good one. But before they part ways again, before life pulls them down separate paths— Jae-seong is determined to make sure Soo-ah never forgets him. One last chance. One final moment. A love that was left unfinished.

The world didn't end with a bang. It was a flash of light bookended by a long, endless freeze that covered the landscape is white snow. Kindness and compassion were replaced with struggle and the ruthless will to survive. And then, there are the Ashen. New beings with abilities beyond that of normal humans, giving them an edge above all others in the frozen wasteland. In this war, there are no victors, just survivors.

Like Romeo and Juliet, beyond nationality, culture, religion and beliefs… what if different people could meet and fall in love? When a woman for the middle east who has little personal freedom meets with a Korean man with a lot of responsibilities, will they be able to understand each other and fight for their love against their parents’ oppositions, and conservative social norms?  
  
This webtoon was commissioned by the Korean International Trade Association.

Menga is simply known as the vice rep and is bullied. Hanako has moved to Korea but was robbed the first day and has nothing. Na Hong Soo is known as a troublemaker and is in constant trouble. And Eechan is the student body president, very popular and known as Bacchus. It seems they have nothing in common, but this will change soon.

Half-blooded Leon was born between a human and an ogre. But all that returns to him as a half-blood is exploitation and betrayal by humans. 

Leon despises such humans and vows revenge. 

To Leon, who always suffered because he lacked power, fortune comes calling, and he’s given an opportunity to take revenge on humans.

title.en: The Villainess Wants to Go Home

altTitles.es-la: El demonio quiere volver a casa

description.en: A world where everyone is immortal seems to good to be true, but long ago scientist uncovered the secret to immortality and now everyone can live forever. Those that rejected it just died of disease, war, or old age. Eventually, everyone was immortal, but even still there are always those born a little different. In world where no one can die, why can I?

Welcome to the Cake Circus! The circus is leaving for another performance today. Donut wants to get on stage, but what if he messes up? Donut has a long way to go! Will he be able to finish the performance safely?

Ghost Terminal , the transit center of the dead , is a must – visit place for the dead who have left this world before going to the underworld . The dead will stay in the < Ghost Terminal > for 49 days , undergo immigration screening , and only the dead can cross the Nether on a boat bound for the underworld . Seon – woo , who lost his mind in an explosion at Incheon Airport , wakes up in < Ghost Terminal > However , Seon – woo is in a coma , not dead , and he finds out that he has come to < Ghost Terminal > by mistake . While waiting to return to Riseong , Seon – woo hears the news that his wife and daughter , who were together at Incheon Airport , are still trapped at the airport and that the airport is about to collapse . The place where his wife and daughter were imprisoned was in a remote place out of the reach of rescuers , and only Seon – woo knew the location of the place . Seon – woo hurriedly tries to return to Seung – ri but the situation goes against his will , and he ends up being trapped in the terminal . Seon Woo , who had to return to the world to save his family , tries to escape from < Ghost Terminal > with all his might …

The Exorcism Agency is a state-run secret organization whose mission is to protect humans from demonic possession. Taehee Yoon, an exorcist from the Execution Department, is looking for a "genius" who can see and hear ghosts to be his new subordinate. While operating undercover at a high school he meets a mysterious boy... "By the way, how old are you, buddy?"

(Promo chapter for the novel Honbul)

A mystery/action plot: in the 13 hours 13 children spent in space, what had happened?? Not enough of the series has been released to describe it properly. It starts off 8 years after the spaceship incident, centered around one of the 13 children named Bono U. Meyer. He has an IQ of 240 and it seems people who are close to him have [coincidentally, perhaps?] been driven clinically insane. What is going on?
description.ko: 2010년, 세계 각 정상들은 세계평화의 상징이자 새로운 세기를 기념하기 위한 이벤트를 열기로 합의한다. ‘프로젝트 : 12소년 우주여행기’ 즉, 세계 각국에서 2001년에 태어난 12명의 우수한 소년소녀를 선정하여 이들에게 우주여행의 기회를 준다는 것이다. 2010년 새해 첫날, 세계는 축제 분위기에 휩싸이고, 마침내 처음 계획보다 1명이 추가된 13명의 아이들이 뽑혀 예정대로 우주왕복선을 타고 지구 밖으로 나간다. 그런데, 세계인이 지켜보는 가운데 이들을 태운 왕복선과 13시간 동안 통신이 중단되는 사태가 일어난다. 자칫하면 아이들을 우주의 미아로 만들어 버리고 인류의 비극으로 끝날 뻔한 이 사건은, 다행히 통신이 재개되고 왕복선이 무사히 지구에 돌아오며 막을 내린다. 그 후 아이들은 각자의 고향으로 돌아가지만, 이들 13명의 아이들에겐 뭔가 전과 다른 능력과 징후들이 나타나기 시작한다...!!

스타 작가의 그림을 대작하라!

그림에 재능을 가진 이그린과 
타고난 배경과 노력으로 스타 작가가 된 남현.

중요한 그룹전을 앞두고 팔을 다친 남현은 
자신의 작품 절반을 대신 완성해 줄 사람을 찾고 있다.

그녀를 직접 찾아가 설득하고 프로젝트 계약을 맺는다.

남현은 오랜 노력으로 쌓아온 
자신의 독특한 필치와 색감은

남현은 자신의 탁월함을 드러내는 것이, 
그린은 완벽하게 자신을 숨기는 것이 목표인 것. 
서로 다른 목표를 가진 두 사람의

description.en: Two high school girls are complete enemies, and they both are in their own gangs. They fight each other all the time, and to get even with the other, one girl tries to kidnap the other's boyfriend. But the information her right-hand girl gives her is wrong, and they kidnap some really good-looking guy who is NOT the boyfriend of the other girl. You know what happens. They fall in love.

Yoo Nan-Hee is a cheerful high-school girl, and also the president of the drama club. But everything changes when she begins to have feelings for Jang Gook-Yung. When she hears a rumor that Jang Gook Yung is dating the princess of class 12, Oh Eun-Yung, she becomes depressed and ends up getting drunk. Then poor Jang Gook-Yung gets stuck with taking her home but because of an accident, he decides to take her to his house instead.  
  
Once there, she accidentally knocks him out, so she removes the unconscious Jang Gook Yung's clothing for him. The next morning her parents see the shocking image and decide that, to avert a huge scandal, the two must get married! Now they have to try to live a normal life… if they can…

As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be… riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore… How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy!

A One-Shot manhwa series of a girl who came home for the first time in a long time and didn't expect that the handsome guy she met in the bus is the kid who used to live next door.
[Only Jeong Wan]

Married off to the Domine family like a commodity, Amelia lives a loveless and dreary marriage. Unbeknownst to her, she was manipulated into spying on her own husband, ultimately meeting a tragic demise.

Given a second chance at life, Amelia is determined not to repeat the same foolish existence.
She makes an offer to Count Domine.

"I will help you win this war."
"And what do you seek in return?"
"When everything is over... divorce me."
"How come?"
"Where neither love is given nor received, why stay in such a marriage?"

Handshakes were exchanged, and with each passing step, Amelia drew closer to her liberation. But this man... was he always this sweet?

¿El giro? Julius es un fantasma, visible solo para Radia.
ㅤ
Cuando se convierte en su compañero constante, Radia se ve envuelta en una red de contratiempos sobrenaturales que revelan cuán poderoso es realmente Julius.
Y aunque ni siquiera Julius conoce su verdadera identidad todavía, su casi omnipotencia podría ser la clave para que Radia se vengue.
Sin embargo, este poder también podría ocultar un peligro acechante que amenaza con reconfigurar su búsqueda de formas inesperadas y peligrosas...

As a result, Sun Woo-jin enters the social circle of Incheon and builds friendships with nobles.

One day, he meets the members of a Korean independence armed group called “Eobyeolgyo” and receives information about his father’s secret and their proposal.
Determined to join forces with them, he begins to dive into a high-stakes gambling game for the fate of his homeland.

By the time No-eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey to find "Utopia," a rumored safe haven said to hold the cure for the virus. 

But this so-called "Utopia" may not be what it seems...
description.pt-br: Toda criança não sonha com um mundo sem adultos? "Your Highness, no, you know what His Majesty the Emperor always used to say. 'I will never marry you, not even if I die!'"

title.en: The Thrilling Temptation of a Boyfriend

description.en:
"We're thirty-two. The age we said we'd start dating."

Top singer in South Korea and a friend of 17 years.
The so-called too comfortable guy friend, Kim Do-kyung.

“If we’re still single at thirty-two, let’s just date.”
“Im Ji-yoo, are you really sure about that?”

Who would’ve thought he’d still remember those words spoken as a joke 12 years ago?

"Are you crazy? Me and you? Ugh, that’s ridiculous..."
"Ten minutes. I’ll seduce you in ten."

Do-kyung picked up his phone and pressed the stopwatch.
As Ji-yoo flinched in surprise, he pulled her waist as if to say, don’t be nervous.

Then, he devoured her lips.

The alarm rang, signaling that ten minutes had passed—and Do-kyung paused for a moment.
Their clothes were already scattered beneath the bed.
Seeing Ji-yoo’s flushed, peach-colored face, he smiled in satisfaction and asked,

“Girlfriend? Friend? Choose.”

The guy friend who had always felt like a brother... turned out to be an homme fatale.
His sexy, beast-like touch—she didn’t hate it.

No, in fact, she liked it.

This place is within the game world.

When architect Jae embarks on a solo vacation to Spain, it may seem that she’s running from her past, away from her abusive ex-boyfriend who sought to control her life. For Jae, however, the trip represents a new chapter as she learns to stand on her own again. Her vacation takes an interesting turn when she’s mistakenly assigned to the same hotel room as Joff, a handsome and successful businessman who is intrigued by Jae’s kind and independent nature. Meanwhile, a sinister figure from Jae’s past begins to haunt her once again…

Ahrah Shin was secretly in love with Seungwoo Han, her childhood friend. 

Unable to express her feelings, she wrote a novel, molded the male lead after him, and confessed her love in the pages. 

He never read it, but everyone else did, and her first novel was a hit!

There's only one issue... he's the CEO of her publishing company!
